title: 2024 GREEN Easter PEEPS Bunny Tumbler Cup Green Straw 14 oz ZAK
categoryName: Home & Garden:Kitchen, Dining & Bar:Kitchen Storage & Organization:Vacuum Flasks & Mugs
descriptionText:
Enjoy your favorite beverage in this festive 2024 Easter PEEPS Bunny Tumbler Cup by Zak! The 14 oz cup features a twist lid and a green straw, perfect for sipping on a refreshing drink. The cup is made of durable plastic and is decorated with the iconic Easter Peeps character family.

This tumbler is ideal for the holiday season and makes a great addition to any kitchen or dining area. Measuring 7 inches in height and 3.5 inches in width, this cup is perfect for both children and adults. Whether you're using it for a party or just for everyday use, this cup is sure to bring a smile to your face.
